solutions.title: DFS connectivity cycle
solutions.strategy: Reject wrong edge count, then traverse from node zero and verify every node is reached.

timeComplexity.explanation: The adjacency list and traversal visit each node and edge.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The graph and visited set are stored.

solutions.title: Union-Find
solutions.strategy: Reject wrong edge count, then union every edge and fail if an edge connects nodes already in the same set.

timeComplexity.explanation: Union-Find operations are nearly constant time.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Parent and rank arrays store one entry per node.
